models.headlineStat: The single headline metric for today — total litter items detected on the Lederhof, with the change vs. yesterday and a 14-day sparkline.
models.trendPoint: A single point in the trend-over-time chart — one calendar date and the litter count detected on that date.
models.intervention: A currently running measure on the square — campaign, signage, design change, or new bin placement — with a title, short description, and start date.
models.heroCta: The single primary call-to-action shown under the headline stat, sending the visitor to the Take Action section.

relationships: headlineStat is independent — one record represents 'today'.
trend is an ordered list of trendPoint records, one per day, oldest first.
activeInterventions is a list of intervention records currently in flight.
heroCta is a single record with a label and an href.

activeInterventions.title: Painted footprints to the bins
activeInterventions.description: Bright lime footprints on the pavement leading visitors from the busiest seating area to the nearest waste bins, nudging disposal at the moment of leaving.

activeInterventions.title: Cigarette voting ashtrays
activeInterventions.description: Two transparent ashtrays at the south entrance posing a playful weekly question; visitors vote with their butts. Designed to convert disposal into a small act of identity.

activeInterventions.title: Saturday-morning citizen sweep
activeInterventions.description: Volunteer-led 30-minute cleaning ritual every Saturday at 9:00, with a coffee reward at the corner café. Currently in week 3 of a six-week pilot.

activeInterventions.title: Reframed signage at north gate
activeInterventions.description: Replaced the old 'no littering' sign with a humorous illustration thanking visitors for keeping the square living and clean.
